methods.name: Semi-LM
methods.summary: A semi-supervised learning framework for landslide mapping that integrates multiperspective consistency learning (MCL) to align input, feature, and model perturbation predictions. It introduces a dual-branch anchor CutMix (DACM) to preserve landslide features and a feature perturbation assign (FPA) strategy to optimize the model in high-dimensional feature space.
methods.verbatim: we propose a reliable multiperspective consistency SSL framework called Semi-LM.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory datasets are mentioned but not linked, and the custom code for the Semi-LM method is not available.
